end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 /* Below block added to handle time zone changes */
 declare
 v_local_date DATE;
 begin
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED 
 then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:instru_log.status_dats,v_local_date);
 :instru_log.status_dats := v_local_date;
 end if;
 end;

 begin
 select substr(code_desc,1,15)
 into :instru_log.status_desc
 from master_codes
 where code_type = 'XMTST'
 and code = :instru_log.xmt_status;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :instru_log.status_desc := 'Unknown Code';
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 begin
 select reconcile_user_id into :s_user_id
 from test_batch_det
 where tb_id = :instru_log.tb_id and
 test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 test_id = :instru_log.test_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :instru_log.s_user_id := ' ';
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-EXIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 read_dats date ;
 tb_id VARCHAR2(14);
 test_id VARCHAR2(10);
 machine_id VARCHAR2(6);
begin
 if :system.cursor_block = 'INSTRU_LOG'
 then
 read_dats := :ctrl_block_1.read_dats;
 tb_id := :ctrl_block_1.tb_id;
 test_id := :ctrl_block_1.test_id;
 machine_id := :ctrl_block_1.machine_id;
--
 :ctrl_block_1.read_dats := NULL;
 :ctrl_block_1.tb_id := NULL;
 :ctrl_block_1.test_id := NULL;
 :ctrl_block_1.machine_id := NULL;
--
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_block('ctrl_block_1');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 :ctrl_block_1.read_dats := read_dats;
 :ctrl_block_1.tb_id := tb_id;
 :ctrl_block_1.test_id := test_id;
 :ctrl_block_1.machine_id := machine_id;
 :ctrl_block_1.chapter_id := :global.chapter_id;
 else
 exit_form(no_validate);
 end if;
end;
